purpose: Phase 1 envelope sanity test of bielik-11b-v30 (BF16, TP=2) on dual-R9700 / vLLM 0.19.0+rocm721 stack via OpenAI-compatible vllm serve endpoint. Direct A/B comparison vs TP=1 baseline from same session (2026-05-17-bielik-11b-v30-vllm-tp1-bf16.json).

config.port_note: Port 8101 used because :8000 occupied by ai-dashboard (long-running) and :8100 reserved for parallel agent (bge-m3 relocation). Identical hardware path otherwise.

load_time_breakdown.method: wall-clock from vllm-banner timestamp 22:03:00 to 'Application startup complete' 22:03:24; corroborated by curl-poll on /v1/models (first 200 OK at 22:03:26 within 5s poll resolution). Faster weights load vs TP=1 (2.59s vs 11.65s) because each worker loads only its shard concurrently.

vram_per_gpu_note: rocm-smi --showmeminfo vram --csv sampled after model load with request idle. card0 = 31.061987328 GiB, card1 = 31.061950464 GiB — perfectly symmetric (Δ = 37 KB, sub-pagesize noise). TP=2 sharding holds model equally across both R9700. card2 (iGPU RAPHAEL) at 1.46 GiB excluded per ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES — that's the parallel bge-m3 relocation agent, not our footprint.
model_footprint_worker_note: Per-worker; 'Model loading took 10.46 GiB memory and 2.59 seconds' from gpu_model_runner.py:4820 (Worker_TP0). Total model parameters across both workers ≈ 20.92 GiB, consistent with TP=1 single-worker 20.9 GiB footprint — confirms TP=2 splits weights evenly with negligible duplication overhead.
kv_cache_available_gb_note: Per-worker 'Available KV cache memory: 17.55 GiB' from gpu_worker.py:436. TP=2 frees substantially more KV memory per worker (17.55 vs 7.17 GiB TP=1) because each worker only holds half the model weights, leaving more of the gpu_memory_utilization=0.9 budget for cache.
kv_cache_gb_note: vLLM 0.19 introspection path does not expose gpu_cache_size_bytes directly (same gap as TP=1 and 4.5B). Token-level capacity 183,968 = 4.90× TP=1 (37,584). Larger-than-expected: naive expectation was 2× (double KV budget), but TP=2 also splits KV cache shards, so per-token memory is half — net effect 2× memory × 2× density = ~4× capacity.
max_concurrency_note: 'Maximum concurrency for 8192 tokens per request: 22.46x' from kv_cache_utils.py:1324. TP=1 reported 4.59×. Ratio 22.46/4.59 = 4.89× — matches kv_cache_size_tokens ratio (183968/37584 = 4.90×) exactly. This is the engineering reason TP=2 exists for this model.

test_response_note: Byte-for-byte identical to TP=1 response (greedy/sampling at temperature=0.7 + same prompt → deterministic-ish output for this short window). Off-protocol observation: acronym expansion 'Positive End-Expiratory Pressure' is clinically correct; this is a smoke-pipeline observation, NOT a capability claim per METHODOLOGY §8.
test_response_time_note: End-to-end curl POST → JSON response, includes HTTP roundtrip + tokenization. Truncated at max_tokens=128 (finish_reason=length). Essentially identical to TP=1 (8.664s) at N=1 because the single-stream critical path is dominated by sequential decode steps, not parallelizable across TP ranks.
throughput_note: Engine-side single-prompt throughput values and the TP=1/TP=2 comparison EMBARGOED §11.3 (Polish-language model); redacted from the public record 2026-06-01. Qualitative point retained: single-stream throughput is lower under TP=2 (inter-rank synchronization overhead); the TP=2 benefit (larger max_concurrency) realizes only at high N, to be quantified by the embargoed Phase 2 sweep. Static envelope remains PUBLIC per §11.1.
issues_encountered: kill_method footnote: initial `kill $(cat /tmp/bielik-11b-v30-tp2.pid)` killed the bash wrapper script (PID 156669) but not the vllm subprocess tree (APIServer pid 156674, EngineCore 156927, Worker_TP{0,1} 157182/157183). nohup + & disconnected the children from the wrapper's process group, so SIGTERM did not propagate. Required follow-up `kill 156674` on the actual APIServer pid; clean shutdown completed in <1s with proper EngineCore + worker shutdown messages. Lesson: for nohup'd vllm serve under bash -c, pidfile must capture the vllm child pid (e.g. from `pgrep -f 'vllm serve.*8101'` after launch), not the wrapper $!. To be patched in v0.3 sanity runner.
kill_method: Two-step: (1) SIGTERM to wrapper PID 156669 from /tmp/bielik-11b-v30-tp2.pid (no effect on children), (2) SIGTERM to actual APIServer pid 156674. Clean shutdown in <1s, no SIGKILL needed, no pkill -f used (per Debug-watch collateral-kill discipline). Post-kill VRAM card0=59.9 MB, card1=59.9 MB confirms full release.
